title: Help
subtitle: How to do things in the app — briefly, with hints right on the elements.
footer: Didn't find an answer? Write to us — we'll add it. And we keep expanding in-app hints: an interactive tour across the interface is planned.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.q0: What do the cards at the top show?
dashboard.a0: Key metrics: students' debt, today's lessons, homework to grade and average attendance — a quick snapshot of your workspace.
dashboard.q1: What is the chart and what is "potential"?
dashboard.a1: Income and debt by period: paid (green), unpaid (yellow) and potential — how much future lessons will bring before attendance is marked.
dashboard.q2: How do I create something quickly?
dashboard.a2: The "Create" button on the dashboard is a shortcut: a new group, homework or a payment record without navigating through sections.

groups.title: Groups
groups.q0: How do I create a group?
groups.a0: The "+ Create group" button: set a name, price per lesson, schedule (days/time) and, optionally, a chat link. Lessons for 3 months are generated automatically.
groups.q1: How do I add a student without registration (no account)?
groups.a1: Inside the group → "+ No account": enter a name and contact. The student gets nothing; attendance and debt are counted for them immediately. Later you can transfer them to a real account.
groups.q2: How do I invite a real student?
groups.a2: Inside the group → "+ Invite": find the student by username (@username) and send a group invitation — they accept it on their side.
groups.q3: How do I add or edit a group lesson?
groups.a3: Inside the group → "Lessons" tab → "+ Lesson": date, time, topic. There you can also open, edit or delete a lesson. When a group is created with a schedule, lessons for 3 months are created automatically.
groups.q4: Where is the group chat link?
groups.a4: In the group settings you can add a link to an external chat (Telegram/WhatsApp) — it appears as a "Group chat" button in the group header and in the lesson card.
groups.q5: A no-account student created an account — how do I transfer the history?
groups.a5: For that student in the group, click "Transfer" and choose their real account — all attendance, payments and homework are re-linked, and the old record is deleted. Nothing is lost.

homework.title: Homework
homework.a0: "+ Create homework": write a description, choose a lesson (group or individual) and a due date. Students see it with the deadline.
homework.q1: How do I check submissions and grade them?
homework.a1: Open the assignment → see students' submissions (file/comment) and statuses. Enter a grade 0–100 — it appears for the student.

attendance.title: Attendance (journal)
attendance.a0: In the journal (students × dates grid) click a cell: ✓ present / N absent. Clicking a date in the header marks the whole lesson as present. At the bottom — "Save".
attendance.a1: Green ✓ — present (confirmed), red N — absent, yellow — awaiting the student's confirmation or a dispute. Blue border — not saved.
attendance.q2: Where do "Disputed" come from and what to do with them?
attendance.a2: If a student disputed a mark, the record goes to the "Disputed" tab. There you "Accept the student's version" or "Insist on yours" — the dispute is closed.
attendance.q3: How do I mark individual lessons?
attendance.a3: Switch to "Individual" — there's a list of individual lessons, each with ✓ (present) / N (absent) buttons. For no-account students, attendance is confirmed immediately.

payments.title: Finances
payments.q0: How do I record a student's payment?
payments.a0: On the "Finances" page, for the right student — "Record", enter the amount. The balance is recalculated immediately.
payments.a1: Debt = charged − paid. Charged — the sum of prices of lessons where the student was marked present; paid — the sum of recorded payments.

students.title: Students
students.q0: Where is the list of my students?
students.a0: The "Students" section — all your students: real ones (with an account) and manually added. There's a search by name/username. The "no account" badge marks students without app access.

calendar.title: Schedule
calendar.a0: All lessons by date: group (blue) and individual (pink). Click a lesson for details and the meeting link.

individual-courses.title: Individual courses
individual-courses.q0: How do I create a course and its lessons?
individual-courses.a0: Create an individual course with a student and a schedule. Inside the course: "Generate a series" (by schedule) or "+ Lesson" (add one manually).

individual-lessons.title: Individual lessons
individual-lessons.q0: How do I create a one-off lesson?
individual-lessons.a0: "+ Create lesson": choose a student (from the list or no account), date, time, price. The lesson appears in the list and calendar.

profile.title: Profile and security
profile.q0: How do I change my password or profile data?
profile.a0: In "Profile" there are tabs: "Profile" (name, username, bio, socials), "Analytics" and "Security" (change password).
profile.q1: How do I set an avatar and cover?
profile.a1: In "Profile" hover over the avatar or cover and click "Replace" — upload an image from your device.
profile.q2: Why do I need a username (@username)?
profile.a2: You are found by username for invitations: a teacher searches for a student by username to invite them to a group. You set your username in "Profile".

quiz.title: AI quizzes
quiz.q0: How do I create a quiz?
quiz.a0: In "Tools → AI quizzes" set a topic, number of questions, difficulty and type — AI builds a quiz with ready answers. Works for any subject.
quiz.q1: How do I save a quiz?
quiz.a1: After generating, click "Save quiz" — it goes to "My quizzes" (your library). From there you can take it for preview and later attach it to homework.
quiz.q2: Where are my quizzes and how do I take them?
quiz.a2: The "My quizzes" section — all saved. Open a quiz → choose answers and "Check" (see the result) or "Show key".

video-calls.title: Video calls
video-calls.q0: How do I join a lesson?
video-calls.a0: In the lesson card (group → Lessons, or Schedule) there's a "Join lesson" button — it opens a Jitsi video meeting in a new tab. The link is created automatically when the lesson is created.
video-calls.q1: How do I become the meeting moderator (manage participants)?
video-calls.a1: When entering Jitsi, click "I'm the host" and sign in via Google or GitHub — then you get moderator rights: muting, recording, removing participants.
video-calls.q2: How do I change the lesson link?
video-calls.a2: Open the lesson → "Edit" → the "Lesson link" field. You can paste your own link (Zoom, Meet) or generate a new one with the "↻ New Jitsi" button.

plans.title: Plans
plans.q0: What are the plans and how do they differ?
plans.a0: Free — free, basic features (a limited number of groups and students). Pro — no limits and priority support. School — several teachers under one brand (in development).
plans.q1: Where do I see my plan and how to upgrade?
plans.a1: Your plan is a small badge next to your name in the left sidebar. Click it — you'll get to the "Plans" page with the description and an "Upgrade" button.

pwa.title: Install as an app
pwa.q0: How do I install Diklaro on a phone (Android / iPhone)?
pwa.a0: Android: open the site in Chrome → three dots (⋮) → "Add to home screen" → "Install". iPhone: open in Safari → "Share" button (rectangle with an arrow) → "Add to Home Screen".
pwa.q1: How do I install on a computer?
pwa.a1: In Chrome/Edge an "Install" icon (a screen with an arrow) appears in the address bar — click it and confirm. Or via the menu: "Install Diklaro". After installation it opens as a separate window without the browser.
pwa.a2: Partially: pages you've already opened load from cache. You can't create lessons or enter data without a connection — syncing with the server is required.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.q0: What does the main screen show?
dashboard.a0: Your snapshot: lessons this week, homework to submit, attendance and debt. Plus upcoming lessons and recent grades.

groups.title: My groups
groups.q0: How do I accept a group invitation?
groups.a0: On "My groups", an "Invitations" block appears at the top — click "Accept", and the group is added. A teacher can invite you by username.

homework.title: Homework
homework.a0: Open the assignment → "Submit": attach a file (PDF/photo) or write a comment and send it — before the due date.
homework.q1: Where do I see the grade?
homework.a1: After grading, the grade (0–100) appears right in the assignment card with the "Graded" status.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.q0: How do I confirm whether I attended a lesson?
attendance.a0: In the "Confirm" tab, for each lesson you click "Present" or "Absent". If the teacher marked it wrong — dispute it, and the teacher will see the dispute.

payments.title: Finances
payments.q0: Where do I see my debt?
payments.a0: On "Finances" — debt for each teacher: charged, paid and balance. Calculated automatically from your lessons.

calendar.title: Schedule
calendar.q0: Where is the schedule and the lesson link?
calendar.a0: In "Schedule" you see all your lessons. Click a lesson for details and the "Go to lesson" button (the call link).

profile.title: Profile
profile.q0: Why do I need a username (@username)?
profile.a0: By username a teacher finds you to invite you to a group. Set a username in "Profile" so you can be invited.
profile.q1: How do I change my password?
profile.a1: In "Profile" → "Security" tab → change password. Forgot your password — there's a "Forgot password?" on the sign-in page.

quiz.title: AI quizzes
quiz.q0: How do I make a quiz for myself?
quiz.a0: In "Tools → AI quizzes" set a topic (any subject), number of questions and type — AI builds the quiz. Handy for self-testing before a test.
quiz.q1: How do I take it and save the result?
quiz.a1: Choose answers → "Check" (see how many are correct) → "Save result". The attempt with a grade goes to your history.
quiz.a2: The "My quizzes" section — all taken, with your result. Open one — see your answers and the correct ones.

video-calls.title: Video calls
video-calls.q0: How do I join a lesson?
video-calls.a0: In the lesson card (Schedule or My groups → lesson) there's a "Join lesson" button — click it, a video meeting opens in a new tab. No registration.
video-calls.q1: Do I need an account for a video call?
video-calls.a1: No. As a student you enter right away — just click "Join lesson" and allow camera/microphone in the browser.

pwa.title: Install as an app
pwa.q0: How do I install Diklaro on a phone (Android / iPhone)?
pwa.a0: Android: open the site in Chrome → three dots (⋮) → "Add to home screen" → "Install". iPhone: open in Safari → "Share" button (rectangle with an arrow) → "Add to Home Screen".
pwa.q1: How do I install on a computer?
pwa.a1: In Chrome/Edge an "Install" icon appears in the address bar — click it and confirm. After installation Diklaro opens as a separate window.
